notes: ProjectTransaction requires mandatory fromPeriod/toPeriod. period_scan walks the months from first_period (the pilot tenant has no documents before 202512; v1's own backfill starts 202310) to the current month, one walk per month, on every run: one wide window gets slower with every page until it times out, a current-month window drops all older documents, and the checkpoint holds no usable watermark because the response has no top-level modification timestamp. An explicit --date-from/--date-to window replaces the range. The key includes _scan_period (the month a row was fetched under) because a ModulePM transaction keeps its refNbr month after month, each month's window holding only that month's lines: ModulePM 1400592 of Aquatiq Sense came back with 68, 66 and 66 lines in 202310, 202311 and 202312. Keyed on module + refNbr alone the later months overwrite the earlier ones (v1's key), and the sync rejects the duplicates. Lower first_period if a tenant has older documents; an empty month costs one request.
